title: The live 87a7 tooth reads the chart, not a typed copy of it
intention: The tester's live 87a7 tooth reads the files 87a7f1c7ae21 charted, and the instrument, the way hollow's measure reads them, so no file in class-space carries the departed bus_client path as a literal.
why: Law 9 and Law 8: a standing red in bus_client's sealed proof (tooth v, every importer at the new address) leaves the component red and blocks any bus_client ticket's criteria. Law 1: the tooth now reads what measure reads instead of a copy of it. Law 3: measured 2026-10-18, tooth v red naming only this file.
traces_to: Law 9 and Law 8: a standing red in bus_client's sealed proof (tooth v, every importer at the new address) leaves the component red and blocks any bus_client ticket's criteria. Law 1: the tooth now reads what measure reads instead of a copy of it. Law 3: measured 2026-10-18, tooth v red naming only this file.
how: In cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_named_build_commit_follows_a_moved_file.py test_the_live_87a7_build_anchors_at_its_parent, replace the hand-typed files list (which names cairn/tools/base/bus_client.py) with hollow.writes_to(ticket), and pass instrument=instrument_set(proven_by(ticket), _REPO_ROOT) to build_anchor, which is what measure does. Measured 2026-10-18 with the change applied aside: the anchor is still 18e1923d^ (80157b30), and cairn/tools/bus_client/proofs/test_the_three_faces_resolve_a_shim_from_disk.py tooth v turns green. Builder notes: Questions a Haiku builder would need, answered. (a) Only cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_named_build_commit_follows_a_moved_file.py changes, inside test_the_live_87a7_build_anchors_at_its_parent. (b) The exact change is the unified diff kept beside the ticket's decision D1, applied verbatim. (c) The PROVES key for this ticket is already in cairn/tools/bus_client/proofs/test_the_three_faces_resolve_a_shim_from_disk.py, committed red-first; the builder edits nothing there. (d) Run both proofs with bin/cairn test; expect both green.
falsifier: Falsifier, clause (1): cairn/tools/bus_client/proofs/test_the_three_faces_resolve_a_shim_from_disk.py exits 0 under bin/cairn test with tooth v green, and cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_named_build_commit_follows_a_moved_file.py stays green, its live tooth still anchoring at 18e1923d^. Measured 2026-10-18: red today, with tooth v naming only cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_named_build_commit_follows_a_moved_file.py; with the change applied aside, both green. Horizon: PROVED, with the hollow revert of cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_named_build_commit_follows_a_moved_file.py redding tooth v.
watchme: none, because the outcome is a structural property measured by cairn/tools/bus_client/proofs/test_the_three_faces_resolve_a_shim_from_disk.py tooth v, which reruns at every bin/cairn test --seal touching bus_client; a recurrence shows as that tooth red in the reseal at commit

decisions.text:
D2 (supersedes D1, which was 6c9db321d638's builder_check carried in by the stale sorted berth this ticket was first cast against): Only cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_named_build_commit_follows_a_moved_file.py changes, in test_the_live_87a7_build_anchors_at_its_parent; nothing in bus_client or hollow.py is edited. Apply exactly this unified diff:
--- cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_named_build_commit_follows_a_moved_file.py
+++ cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_named_build_commit_follows_a_moved_file.py
@@ -121,13 +121,18 @@
     cairn/tools/bus_client/bus_client.py before its build 18e1923d. Its named build_commits
     anchor at 18e1923d^ — never a refusal, never a later commit (Law 8). Invariant, not a
     snapshot: the parent is read from git, not written here."""
-    from cairn.devices.tester.hollow import COMMONS, _roots
+    from cairn.devices.tester.hollow import (COMMONS, _roots, instrument_set, proven_by,
+                                             writes_to)
     tid, first = "87a7f1c7ae21", "18e1923d06e13995084b72751801d4ccfd5d9f17"
     ticket = json.loads(next((Path(COMMONS) / "tickets").glob(f"{tid}-*.json")).read_text())
     assert first in (ticket.get("build_commits") or []), ticket.get("build_commits")
-    files = ["cairn/devices/inference_domain/device.py", "cairn/tools/base/bus_client.py"]
+    # The files are what 87a7's chart CLAIMS and the instrument is its proofs, read the way
+    # ``measure`` reads them — never typed here, so the departed path stays in the chart that
+    # named it rather than living on as a literal in class-space (ticket 05662f9e9bc9).
+    files = writes_to(ticket)
+    instrument = instrument_set(proven_by(ticket), _REPO_ROOT)
     try:
-        f = build_anchor(ticket, files, roots=_roots(), repo_root=_REPO_ROOT)
+        f = build_anchor(ticket, files, roots=_roots(), repo_root=_REPO_ROOT, instrument=instrument)
     except HollowUnmeasurable as why:
         raise AssertionError(f"87a7's true build_commits were refused: {why}")
     parent = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(_REPO_ROOT), "rev-parse", f"{first}^"],
Then run bin/cairn test cairn/tools/bus_client/proofs/test_the_three_faces_resolve_a_shim_from_disk.py (tooth v red before, green after) and bin/cairn test cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_named_build_commit_follows_a_moved_file.py (green; the live tooth anchors at 18e1923d^). — CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-12 'approved thru PROVED, fastest route'
